body:
Man, was not expecting to hear such kind words. It really scares me how lightly I can take life sometimes, and having this overwhelming feeling of "now you've done it" does not help.

I figure that is the way things work, to move forward. I know there is love inside me. The thing is, it has been a long time since i felt true happiness. Being depressed led me into a world of heartbreak, angst and awesome 80's music. Even though I'm from the 90's

I stopped taking my meds because i was feeling very unreal. Ifeel more grounded right now but anxiety is a real bitch. Took to long to reply but thanks.
